name: Albuquerque Exotic Woods
old_description: A white application pad used for applying Rubio Monocoat oils. Use it as a stand-alone applicator or as a refill to the Applicator Set. The synthetic scrubby fibers are less absorptive then a rag, allowing for less waste.
about:
Albuquerque Exotic Woods operates a retail showroom at 1570 Juan Tabo Boulevard Northeast in Albuquerque, New Mexico. The company's founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed, and no founders are named in available sources.

The business stocks a selection of exotic hardwoods and related finishing supplies, including Rubio Monocoat oils and dedicated application pads designed for low-waste oil application. It also runs hands-on woodworking classes, such as an upcoming epoxy workshop, from its physical store, which is open Tuesday through Saturday from 9 a.m. to 6 p.m. The product catalog lists items like Oil Plus Part A in 100 mL containers.

The store serves woodworkers, hobbyists, and DIY enthusiasts looking for specialty lumber and finishing products. Customers can visit the showroom to select materials in person or attend instructional classes to build skills. The company maintains an Instagram presence under the handle @abq_exotic_woods for updates and community engagement.

The company has not published a formal mission statement or origin story explaining why it was started or what sets it apart from other lumber retailers.
